ja:
{COL:0A}4にんは　ひかりのなかで
{COL:07}そのいしを　そのこころを　かんじとり
{COL:0A}たびだつ　けついをした
en:
{COL:0A}Within the light, the four
{COL:07}sensed its will and its heart,
{COL:0A}and resolved to set out.

ja:
{COL:0A}さあ　やみをふりはらい
{COL:0D}ふたたび
{COL:07}このせかいに　ひかりをとりもどすのだ
en:
{COL:0A}Now, sweep away the darkness
{COL:0D}and once again
{COL:07}bring light back to this world,

ja: {COL:06}クリスタルのひかりを　きぼうにかえて‥‥

{COL:05}さいしょは　なにもない　むの　せかいだった
{COL:08}あるとき　ひかりと　やみができた
{COL:09}すべては　そこから　うまれた
{COL:05}ほし　つき　みず　ひ‥‥　　そして　いのち
{COL:03}ときは　それをまた　もとのばしょに　かえそうとする
en:
{COL:05}In the beginning was a world of nothingness, where nothing was.
{COL:08}At one time, light and darkness came to be.
{COL:09}From there, all things were born.
{COL:05}Stars, moon, water, fire... and then, life.
{COL:03}Time seeks to return them again to where they began.

ja:
{COL:04}だが　いのちは　さらに　べつのものをうみだした
{COL:0A}ひかりと　やみをわけ
{COL:04}そのかがやきをもって　せかいを　てらしだすもの
{COL:08}きぼう　という　エネルギーを‥‥
en:
{COL:04}But life gave birth to yet another thing:
{COL:0A}that which divides light and darkness,
{COL:04}and with its radiance lights up the world,
{COL:08}the energy called hope...

ja:
{COL:06}いつかまた　ひかりと　やみが　かさなり
{COL:07}すべてが　むに　かえろうとするとき
{COL:06}それを2つに　わけるものが　あらわれる
{COL:0B}わすれてはならない
{COL:03}そのものに　ちからをあたえているのは　ひとびとの
{COL:0A}きぼうだということを‥‥
en:
{COL:06}When someday light and darkness overlap again
{COL:07}and all things are about to return to nothingness,
{COL:06}those who divide it in two will appear.
{COL:0B}Do not forget
{COL:03}that what gives them their power is the people's
{COL:0A}hope...

ja:
{COL:09}ときは　すべてを　おしながす
{COL:0A}ゆめ　ぜつぼう　あい‥‥
{COL:08}だが　それを　うけいれてはならない
{COL:0B}ながされてはいけない
{COL:08}そこに　みいださなければならない
en:
{COL:09}Time sweeps everything away:
{COL:0A}dreams, despair, love...
{COL:08}But you must not accept it.
{COL:0B}You must not be swept away.
{COL:08}You must find it there:

ja:
{COL:07}さいごにのこった　1つぶの　かがやき
{COL:09}すべてをてらしだす　かがやき
{COL:0D}きぼうを‥‥
en:
{COL:07}the one last grain of radiance remaining,
{COL:09}the radiance that lights up all things,
{COL:0D}hope...
